mapper.sql: id, region, title, description, reward_points, status, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.region, COALESCE(c.task_title,t.title) AS title, COALESCE(c.task_description,t.description) AS description, COALESCE(c.reward_points,t.reward_points) AS reward_points, t.status, t.created_at, COALESCE(c.status, 0) AS claim_status, c.id AS claim_id, c.review_note,c.evidence_type,c.evidence_id,c.submission_note,c.submission_version FROM creator_task t LEFT JOIN creator_task_claim c ON c.task_id=t.id AND c.user_id=#{userId} WHERE t.region=#{region} AND ((t.status=1 AND t.is_deleted=FALSE) OR c.id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM creator_task WHERE region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM creator_task WHERE region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT FROM creator_task WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
SELECT * FROM creator_task_claim WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND user_id=#{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO creator_task_claim(task_id, user_id, region, status,task_title,task_description,reward_points) VALUES(#{taskId}, #{userId}, #{region}, 1,#{taskTitle},#{taskDescription},#{rewardPoints})

INSERT INTO creator_task(region, title, description, reward_points, status) VALUES(#{region}, #{title}, #{description}, #{rewardPoints}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE creator_task SET title=#{title}, description=#{description}, reward_points=#{rewardPoints}, status=#{status}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND region=#{region} AND is_deleted=FALSE
